experiences.name: Hanoi Old Quarter Street Food Tour
experiences.description: Wander through the bustling 36 streets of Hanoi's Old Quarter sampling iconic Vietnamese dishes including Bun Cha, Banh Mi, Pho, and Egg Coffee from legendary local vendors and hole-in-the-wall eateries. Join a self-guided or budget walking tour to discover hidden alleyway kitchens and interact with locals.

experiences.name: Hoi An Ancient Town Lantern Festival & Night Market
experiences.description: Explore the UNESCO-listed Ancient Town of Hoi An on foot, visiting centuries-old merchant houses, Japanese covered bridges, and tailor shops. Stay for the monthly lantern festival or nightly market where you can release paper lanterns on the Thu Bon River and feast on White Rose dumplings and Cao Lau noodles for just a few dollars.

experiences.name: Motorbiking the Hai Van Pass
experiences.description: Rent a motorbike or join a budget group tour to ride the legendary Hai Van Pass, a dramatic mountain road stretching between Da Nang and Hue offering breathtaking coastal views, jungle scenery, and old French and American war bunkers. A quintessential backpacker experience made famous by Top Gear.
experiences.location: Hai Van Pass, between Da Nang and Hue

experiences.name: Mekong Delta Sampan Boat & Local Market Visit
experiences.description: Take a budget day trip from Ho Chi Minh City into the Mekong Delta, hopping on a traditional sampan boat through narrow canals lined with coconut palms. Visit floating markets, local coconut candy workshops, and rice paper factories while sampling tropical fruits and fresh seafood straight from the river.

experiences.name: Bui Vien Walking Street & Backpacker Night Scene
experiences.description: Dive into the heart of Ho Chi Minh City's legendary backpacker district on Bui Vien Street. Enjoy cheap draft Bia Hoi beer, grilled street skewers, fresh spring rolls, and vibrant live music spilling out of open-air bars. A must-do social hub for budget travelers to swap stories and plan onward adventures.
experiences.location: Bui Vien Street, Pham Ngu Lao Backpacker District, Ho Chi Minh City
